summary: NIFTY on NSE_INDEX: an index tick has no trade time, so no ltt or last_trade_time in any mode. An LTP client, then a Quote client on the same index: Sahi holds one mode per instrument, so the Quote subscription is a ModeChange, and the Quote tick serves both.

notes: Depth on an index is not cased: the desktop sends the index tick's frame and its book's frame, both without a book (feed/protocol.rs market_data leaves the book out for an index), to a Depth client, and the feed server may fold the two into one; the web sends one frame with a padded empty book.

deviations.reason: A Quote tick's open interest is not marked carried, so a Quote frame from a Quote tick has no oi, or the OI of the connection's last Depth tick. The web sends the tick's open_interest (sahi_mapping.py build_quote_payload).
The web's alias of oi, sent beside it with the same value; follows oi (see oi).

The tick left the price band off (dpr_upper, a proto3 scalar, reads as 0); the web publishes upper_circuit 0.0 (sahi_mapping.py build_quote_payload), a band nobody sent. The desktop sends none for an instrument whose ticks never carried one, and keeps the band an earlier tick of the connection carried.
The tick left the price band off (dpr_lower); the web publishes lower_circuit 0.0, as upper_circuit.
